messages:
maria: Kicking off deploy for service-infer at 21:05 UTC. Rolling 2 pods per region. Will run quick post-deploy checks. @kevin can you watch infra metrics? @aj can you run the latency sweep?
release-bot: Deploy started: release/2026-03-15-1769. CI ✅, canary rolling.
kevin: On it — watching GPU and host metrics. I'll call out if queue grows or OOMs appear.
aj: Ready to run perf sweep once canary health green.
devon: Quick sanity checklist for people: 1) /health 2) kubectl logs tail 3) p95 latency < 150ms 4) error rate < 0.5% 5) no new 5xx spikes
maria: Running curl health: ```curl -sS https://canary.infer.redwood/api/health | jq .status``` -> "ok"
sre-jen: Traces look clean from first samples; no obvious tail latency from recent requests.
kevin: Infra snapshot: GPU util ~32%, queue length 3, no OOM events, node memory steady.
aj: Latency sweep results (sample): p50 42ms, p95 118ms, p99 205ms — p99 a hair up vs baseline but within tolerable band. Will keep monitoring.
devon: Saw one transient 500 tied to unusual payload shape, opened PR #4213 to add defensive check, running quick unit + canary test. Not a rollback for now.
maria: Agree — don't rollback for a single guarded 500. Roll criteria: errors > 1% sustained for 2 minutes OR p95 > 250ms OR any OOM/segfaults.
release-bot: Canary promotion complete -> stable
maria: Thanks team — marking this deploy as DONE in the release doc and adding the perf graphs. I'll follow up tomorrow with a short postmortem if anything changes. :thumbsup:
